goals.title: Splunk MVP + AWS community visibility
goals.outcome: Become a Splunk MVP and get noticed by the AWS community by January 2027, by publishing two articles a week that engineers actually share. Note: Splunk MVP program rules and criteria must be checked against the official source before planning; none are assumed here.
goals.audience: Engineers in the Splunk and AWS communities
goals.stated: My goal is to become a Splunk MVP and get noticed by the AWS community by January 2027. I want two article a week that engineers actually share.
